user.title: UK Prepper Hub Alerts
user.description:
Weather, flood, river, power cut and health alerts near your home, the national threat level and grid notices, and the UK Prepper Hub daily news.

We've picked **{region}** from your Home Assistant home location. Change it if that's wrong. Location-based checks use your home location, rounded to about 1 km.

Phones ticked below get an alert when something at or above the levels you choose happens.

data.alert_threat_level: Alert me when the national terrorism threat level changes
data.alert_grid: Alert me about national grid supply notices
